title: Somatic Jungian Parts Meditation & Archetypal Meditation on Transforming Shadow and Phobic States 🧘‍♀️✨🌌💖🌀😌🔮💡🌱🙏🎧🌟📖💬💞

sentences.en: Hey guys, it's Joel with the Taproot Therapy Collective podcast, and I want to welcome you to another somatic Jungian-based meditation.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Taproot Therapy Collective 播客的 Joel，欢迎大家参加又一次基于荣格心理学与躯体疗法的冥想练习。

sentences.en: We have gotten a lot of requests to do another one since I have an old one, and I do those fairly differently now, with some principles from
sentences.zh: 自从我发布了之前的冥想音频后，收到了很多制作新内容的请求。我现在采用的方法与过去大不相同，融入了一些新的原则，来自

sentences.en: Somatic Experiencing by Peter Levin, Process-Oriented Therapy by Arnie Mendel,
sentences.zh: Peter Levin 的躯体体验疗法（Somatic Experiencing）、Arnie Mendel 的过程导向心理学（Process-Oriented Therapy），

sentences.en: Voice Dialogue Therapy by Sidra and Hal Stone, and IFS Techniques developed by Richard Schwartz.
sentences.zh: Sidra 和 Hal Stone 的声音对话疗法（Voice Dialogue Therapy），以及 Richard Schwartz 开发的内在家庭系统疗法（IFS）。

sentences.en: These are largely somatic and post-Jungian therapies that build on Jung's insights, and you can read more about them on our website if you're interested.
sentences.zh: 这些主要是基于荣格洞见的躯体疗法和后荣格疗法，如果你感兴趣，可以在我们的网站上阅读更多相关信息。

sentences.en: We've got a lot of biographies and things on our blog, but the therapy meditation that I did on Jungian shadow work was
sentences.zh: 我们的博客上有许多传记和相关资料，但我之前做的关于荣格“阴影工作”的冥想疗法，

sentences.en: one of the most popular things that we released on YouTube, and we got a lot of requests to do another one.
sentences.zh: 是我们 YouTube 上最受欢迎的内容之一，很多人都要求再做一期。

sentences.en: So here's an update of how I do those meditations now.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我目前进行此类冥想方式的更新版。

sentences.en: You want to be sure before you start this that you're in a safe space, a comfortable space, you know, nice temperature, well-fitting
sentences.zh: 在开始之前，请确保你处于一个安全、舒适的空间，比如温度适宜、穿着

sentences.en: clothing, and you just somewhere private where you can relax.
sentences.zh: 合身，并且是一个你可以放松的私密环境。

sentences.en: If there's ambient noise, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果有环境噪音也没关系。

sentences.en: Just make that part of your process of recognizing annoyance as a somatic or a unconscious protective part.
sentences.zh: 只需将其纳入你的过程中，将这种烦躁感识别为一种躯体或潜意识的保护性部分。

sentences.en: Any things that might pop up.
sentences.zh: 任何可能浮现出来的东西都可以。

sentences.en: You're never in the perfect place to do a meditation, but you do want to make sure that you're not driving.
sentences.zh: 你永远无法找到一个完美的冥想场所，但请务必确保你不在开车。

sentences.en: You're not anywhere.
sentences.zh: 你不在任何

sentences.en: It may be dangerous, and we'll go ahead and begin that meditation now.
sentences.zh: 可能存在危险的地方，我们现在就开始冥想。

sentences.en: So I want you to find a nice open posture sitting up or lay down if that's comfortable for you.
sentences.zh: 请找一个舒适的姿势坐好，或者如果你觉得舒服，也可以躺下。

sentences.en: And I want you to just kind of map your psyche for a minute and find the things that you avoid, not just an emotion, but an implicit emotion, a deep relationship between
sentences.zh: 我想让你花一分钟时间梳理一下你的心理，找出那些你一直在回避的事物——不仅仅是一种情绪，而是一种内隐的情绪，一种存在于

sentences.en: your inside world and your outside world, where you feel that you cannot survive, that this is wrong.
sentences.zh: 你的内心世界与外部世界之间的深层关系，在那里你感到无法生存，感到这是错误的。

sentences.en: You know, maybe it's feeling trapped for you.
sentences.zh: 也许对你来说，那是一种被困住的感觉。

sentences.en: Maybe it's feeling less good than other people, feeling inferior.
sentences.zh: 也许是感觉自己不如别人，感到自卑。

sentences.en: Maybe it's feeling powerless, you know, unable to act.
sentences.zh: 也许是感到无力，你知道，无法采取行动。

sentences.en: It might be powerless, like you have to do something, but you're not strong enough.
sentences.zh: 那可能是一种无力感，就像你必须做点什么，但却不够强大。

sentences.en: And it may be a powerlessness, like a paralyzation, like you are wanting to do something, but you don't know how, what, or where that kind of action should come from.
sentences.zh: 也可能是一种瘫痪般的无力感，就像你想要做点什么，却不知道该怎么做、做什么，或者这种行动应该从何而来。

sentences.en: It could be lots of things, but you want to find that feeling that is the hardest place to go for you.
sentences.zh: 这可能是很多事情，但你要找到那个对你来说最难触碰的感觉。

sentences.en: The emotional arc you're either so enmeshed with that you have to feel that way all the time, or that you're so avoidant of that you feel like if you feel it, you'll die.
sentences.zh: 那个情绪弧线，要么是你深陷其中，以至于你不得不时刻感受它；要么是你极力回避，以至于你觉得一旦感受它，你就会死。

sentences.en: I can't go back there.
sentences.zh: 我无法回到那里。

sentences.en: You know, intellectually you understand, most of us do, that this doesn't matter, or it shouldn't
sentences.zh: 在理智上，我们大多数人都明白这并不重要，或者出于种种原因，它不应该

sentences.en: affect us anymore for lots of reasons, but that intellect is not going to help you here.
sentences.zh: 再影响我们了，但这种理智在这里帮不了你。

sentences.en: We have to kind of teach your body and your brainstem, your subcortical brain, that this is
sentences.zh: 我们必须教导你的身体和脑干，即你的皮层下大脑，意识到这

sentences.en: something that you have mastery over now, and that you can go back, and that you can be overwhelmed, and then master this space of emotion.
sentences.zh: 是你现在可以掌控的事情，你可以回到过去，你可以被淹没，然后驾驭这个情绪空间。

sentences.en: So when you find your traumatic memory, your phobia, or your emotional trigger, try and go beneath the event that created it.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你找到你的创伤记忆、恐惧症或情绪触发点时，试着深入到创造它的事件之下。

sentences.en: Don't just try and remember an event that's overwhelming, but turn the event into a state of being that is hard for you.
sentences.zh: 不要只是试图回忆那个让你不知所措的事件，而是将该事件转化为一种对你来说艰难的存在状态。

sentences.en: And so don't analyze it, and don't think about it intellectually, but just listen to the energy of this thing that is your shadow in your body, and see what it activates.
sentences.zh: 不要去分析它，也不要从理智上去思考它，只需倾听你身体里作为“阴影”的能量，看看它激活了什么。

sentences.en: See where it is inhabiting the most intensely.
sentences.zh: 看看它最强烈地占据了你身体的哪个部位。

sentences.en: You know, is it that you feel your spine wanting to curl into a ball to make yourself smaller, or to protect yourself with a rigidity?
sentences.zh: 你知道，是你的脊椎想要蜷缩成一团以让自己变小，还是想要通过僵硬来保护自己？

sentences.en: Is it that you are wanting to stand up tall and tight and fight, make yourself larger, less inferior?
sentences.zh: 是你想要挺直身体、紧绷起来去战斗，让自己变得更高大，减少自卑感吗？

sentences.en: Or is it just kind of a looseness that you want to wriggle away?
sentences.zh: 还是说那是一种想要扭动着逃离的松弛感？

sentences.en: You want to move?
sentences.zh: 你想要移动吗？

sentences.en: Just don't think about this.
sentences.zh: 不要去思考这些。

sentences.en: Let go, and notice what your spine is doing when you inhabit the space and your emotional spectrum.
sentences.zh: 放手，观察当你置身于这个空间和情绪光谱中时，你的脊椎在做什么。

sentences.en: Notice what your hands and your extremities, your fingers, your toes, are they limp?
sentences.zh: 观察你的手和四肢，你的手指、脚趾，它们是无力的吗？

sentences.en: Or are they tingling?
sentences.zh: 还是有刺痛感？

sentences.en: And scan your body for tension.
sentences.zh: 扫描你的身体，寻找紧张感。

sentences.en: And notice if there is tension in your chest, hot or a cold, heavy, a light, or a tight feeling.
sentences.zh: 注意你的胸部是否有紧张感，是热还是冷，是沉重、轻盈，还是紧绷的感觉。

sentences.en: And now notice your stomach.
sentences.zh: 现在注意你的胃部。

sentences.en: If your guts are locking up, there's pain, hunger, blankness.
sentences.zh: 如果你的肠胃紧缩，有疼痛、饥饿感或空白感。

sentences.en: Scan your jawbone.
sentences.zh: 扫描你的下颌骨。

sentences.en: Move your jaw back and forth, left and right.
sentences.zh: 来回移动你的下巴，向左向右。

sentences.en: See if there's tension.
sentences.zh: 看看是否有紧张感。

sentences.en: And sometimes jaw tension shows up creeping from the hinge of the jaw up into the inner ear.
sentences.zh: 有时下颌紧张会从下颌关节蔓延到内耳。

sentences.en: If you have TMJ at night, a lot of the times it will show up as an inner ear pain, where there's no infection or allergy, but there is a pain.
sentences.zh: 如果你晚上有颞下颌关节紊乱（TMJ），很多时候它会表现为内耳疼痛，虽然没有感染或过敏，但确实有疼痛感。

sentences.en: And wherever you've noticed these feelings the most across your body.
sentences.zh: 无论你在身体的哪个部位最明显地注意到了这些感觉。

sentences.en: And I'm not there with you in therapy to listen and to zoom in on them.
sentences.zh: 我不在你身边进行治疗，无法倾听并聚焦于它们。

sentences.en: So you have to find them like a map and don't judge them as good or bad, even if they're overwhelming or they're upsetting or just an unpleasant feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须像看地图一样找到它们，不要评判它们是好是坏，即使它们让你不知所措、心烦意乱，或者仅仅是一种不愉快的感觉。

sentences.en: Just try and turn a curiosity towards them of a kind of sense of wonder of what these things are and what they want.
sentences.zh: 试着对它们产生一种好奇心，一种对这些东西究竟是什么以及它们想要什么的惊奇感。

sentences.en: And just let them float there with you for a moment.
sentences.zh: 让它们和你一起漂浮一会儿。

sentences.en: I want you to notice each somatic feeling at each place that the shadow is showing up in your psyche soma, your mind body.
sentences.zh: 我想让你注意到阴影在你的身心（Psyche-Soma）中出现的每一个躯体感觉和每一个位置。

sentences.en: And I want you to feel each of those spaces and see if you can get temperatures or textures.
sentences.zh: 我想让你感受每一个空间，看看能否捕捉到温度或质感。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to make intellectual sense.
sentences.zh: 它不需要有理智上的逻辑。

sentences.en: VCR static, the fizz when you open a coke, kind of dull pressure like a heavy metal object.
sentences.zh: 像录像带的雪花点，打开可乐时的嘶嘶声，或者像重金属物体那样的沉闷压力。

sentences.en: All of these are perfectly valid things to notice.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都是完全合理的观察。

sentences.en: Is there an emptiness, a denseness, a churning?
sentences.zh: 是一种空虚、稠密，还是翻腾的感觉？

sentences.en: So just sense that energy for a minute.
sentences.zh: 花一分钟去感知那种能量。

sentences.en: And if there's pain, is it electric?
sentences.zh: 如果有疼痛，它是电击般的吗？

sentences.en: Is it dull?
sentences.zh: 是钝痛吗？

sentences.en: Is it piercing?
sentences.zh: 是刺痛吗？

sentences.en: Is it throbbing?
sentences.zh: 是跳痛吗？

sentences.en: Is it imploding?
sentences.zh: 是内爆感吗？

sentences.en: Don't stop at just pain.
sentences.zh: 不要只停留在疼痛上。

sentences.en: Wonder.
sentences.zh: 去好奇。

sentences.en: Wonder what it is and stay curious.
sentences.zh: 好奇它是什么，保持好奇心。

sentences.en: So we're still in a metacognitive space that is aware of the thing, but outside of it.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然处于一个元认知空间，既意识到这个事物，又置身于它之外。

sentences.en: Don't become possessed by it.
sentences.zh: 不要被它占据。

sentences.en: Don't decide what it means you have to do or what you are, what you have to be.
sentences.zh: 不要决定它意味着你必须做什么，或者你是什么，你必须成为什么。

sentences.en: Just let it be and let you be.
sentences.zh: 让它成为它，让你成为你。

sentences.en: And while you are being, notice what it is doing.
sentences.zh: 在保持这种状态的同时，观察它在做什么。

sentences.en: And just curiously feel it for a moment.
sentences.zh: 好奇地感受它一会儿。

sentences.en: And now I want you to let that somatic sensation, wherever that is showing up, spread.
sentences.zh: 现在，我想让你让那种躯体感觉——无论它出现在哪里——扩散开来。

sentences.en: So just give it a minute.
sentences.zh: 给它一分钟时间。

sentences.en: And when you turn your attention to it, see where it wants to go in your body, if it moves.
sentences.zh: 当你把注意力转向它时，看看它想在你的身体里去往哪里，如果它会移动的话。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't want to move, see how it wants to move your body.
sentences.zh: 如果它不想移动，看看它想如何带动你的身体。

sentences.en: Do you want to move left or right, like you're underwater in the flow of something?
sentences.zh: 你想向左还是向右移动，就像你在某种流动的深水下一样？

sentences.en: Do you want to pick your hands up?
sentences.zh: 你想抬起手吗？

sentences.en: Just let it do what it wants to do and see where it wants to go.
sentences.zh: 随它去吧，看看它想去哪里。

sentences.en: And you may feel the pain or the tension or the tightness, whatever it is, move to a new space or connect to another pain that you hadn't noticed was there before.
sentences.zh: 你可能会感觉到疼痛、紧张或紧绷感——无论是什么——移动到了一个新的空间，或者连接到了你之前没注意到的另一个痛点。

sentences.en: Another expression of your relationship to this feeling, this deep, implicit feeling.
sentences.zh: 这是你与这种感觉——这种深层的、内隐的感觉——关系的另一种表达。

sentences.en: It is the root of this emotion that you are not good at, that you have a relationship with, where it possesses you and tells you what to do instead
sentences.zh: 这是你所不擅长处理的情绪的根源，你与它存在一种关系，它占据了你并告诉你该做什么，而不是

sentences.en: of you using it and noticing it, letting it go when you've heard it.
sentences.zh: 你利用它、注意到它，并在听取它之后将其释放。

sentences.en: These things want to be heard because they have something to say that we don't listen to.
sentences.zh: 这些东西想要被倾听，因为它们有我们未曾留意的诉求。

sentences.en: And if you feel it stop as you notice it move around and you feel this process slow down and you feel where it's settled, if it's moved or
sentences.zh: 如果你感觉到它在你观察它移动时停止了，感觉到这个过程慢了下来，感觉到它沉淀的地方，如果它移动了或

sentences.en: changed or connected to other points, connect, as Arnie Mandel would say, to the visual channel.
sentences.zh: 改变了，或者连接到了其他点，就像 Arnie Mandel 所说的，连接到视觉通道。

sentences.en: See if you get an image like a color or a feeling that is not quite visual, like you're in a field or in outer space or in a room.
sentences.zh: 看看你是否能得到一个图像，比如一种颜色，或者一种不太像视觉的感受，就像你身处田野、外太空或某个房间里。

sentences.en: And just notice all of the cosmology that this thing feels around you.
sentences.zh: 注意这个东西在你周围营造出的所有宇宙感。

sentences.en: And even if it's unpleasant or overwhelming or upsetting, just stay with it.
sentences.zh: 即使它是不愉快的、令人不知所措或心烦意乱的，也要坚持住。

sentences.en: With a curiosity, keep a curiosity tuned and open to see what happens next, because we're not going to stay here forever.
sentences.zh: 保持好奇心，保持开放，看看接下来会发生什么，因为我们不会永远停在这里。

sentences.en: You may have memories come back.
sentences.zh: 你可能会想起一些记忆。

sentences.en: Usually not, but sometimes we do.
sentences.zh: 通常不会，但有时会。

sentences.en: If you get a color, remember that color.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到了颜色，记住那个颜色。

sentences.en: And now turn your attention to the auditory channel.
sentences.zh: 现在把注意力转向听觉通道。

sentences.en: And on the auditory channel,
sentences.zh: 在听觉通道上，

sentences.en: I want you to see if you notice
sentences.zh: 我想让你看看是否注意到了

sentences.en: anything
sentences.zh: 任何

sentences.en: that feels like a sound.
sentences.zh: 感觉像是声音的东西。

sentences.en: And sometimes it's like the energy of where a sound would be.
sentences.zh: 有时它就像是声音所在位置的能量。

sentences.en: Not quite something we hear, but something that we
sentences.zh: 不完全是我们听到的东西，而是我们

sentences.en: have in auditory memory that we
sentences.zh: 在听觉记忆中拥有的，我们

sentences.en: almost hear.
sentences.zh: 几乎能听到的东西。

sentences.en: And those are important too.
sentences.zh: 那些也很重要。

sentences.en: They're part of your relationship to this part of self
sentences.zh: 它们是你与这部分自我关系的一部分，

sentences.en: that you are not in good relationship with.
sentences.zh: 而你与这部分自我的关系并不融洽。

sentences.en: Notice if words arise.
sentences.zh: 注意是否有词语浮现。

sentences.en: Idea words.
sentences.zh: 概念词。

sentences.en: Big words.
sentences.zh: 大词。

sentences.en: Mythy words.
sentences.zh: 神话般的词。

sentences.en: Little words.
sentences.zh: 小词。

sentences.en: Even if they're weird or strange and you wonder why that's in your head or you think you're doing it wrong, you're not.
sentences.zh: 即使它们很奇怪，你怀疑为什么它们会出现在脑海里，或者认为自己做错了，其实你并没有。

sentences.en: Just remember those colors and sounds and visual sound-like memories and visual
sentences.zh: 只需记住那些颜色、声音、视觉上的类声音记忆，以及你周围世界是什么样的视觉

sentences.en: memories of what the world is like around you.
sentences.zh: 记忆。

sentences.en: And try and amplify it.
sentences.zh: 试着放大它。

sentences.en: If you feel scared like you're a mouse in a field hiding from a hawk, I want you to get scareder.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到害怕，就像一只在田野里躲避老鹰的老鼠，我希望你更害怕一点。

sentences.en: And if you feel icky like you shouldn't be here, like it's a place that you shouldn't see or you shouldn't allow yourself to make yourself feel worse.
sentences.zh: 如果你感到恶心，觉得你不该在这里，觉得这是一个你不该看到的地方，或者你不该允许自己让自己感觉更糟。

sentences.en: Feel that ick.
sentences.zh: 感受那种恶心感。

sentences.en: Give it more of a visual or sonic character.
sentences.zh: 给它更多视觉或声音上的特征。

sentences.en: Is it like a slime?
sentences.zh: 它像粘液吗？

sentences.en: Does it hear like a glop or a hiss?
sentences.zh: 听起来像粘糊声或嘶嘶声吗？

sentences.en: If you feel like you're not wanted here.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得你不被欢迎在这里。

sentences.en: Try and amplify all parts of this memory.
sentences.zh: 试着放大这段记忆的所有部分。

sentences.en: The sense of space around you.
sentences.zh: 你周围的空间感。

sentences.en: Visual images.
sentences.zh: 视觉图像。

sentences.en: Auditory images.
sentences.zh: 听觉图像。

sentences.en: And somatic experiencing of
sentences.zh: 以及它们对你身体影响的

sentences.en: what they do to your body.
sentences.zh: 躯体体验。

sentences.en: And I want you to enhance that image and make it more vivid.
sentences.zh: 我想让你增强那个图像，让它更生动。

sentences.en: And if it morphs
sentences.zh: 如果它演变成

sentences.en: into kind of a metaphor that doesn't quite fit, just let that be.
sentences.zh: 一种不太贴切的隐喻，就让它那样吧。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to fit into language.
sentences.zh: 它不需要符合语言逻辑。

sentences.en: A lot of these things don't fit into language.
sentences.zh: 很多这类东西都无法用语言表达。

sentences.en: I mean, the shadow starts to disappear when you look at it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当你注视阴影时，它就开始消失了。

sentences.en: Shrink back into different shapes.
sentences.zh: 缩回到不同的形状中。

sentences.en: Just turn it into a metaphor.
sentences.zh: 把它变成一个隐喻。

sentences.en: Are you a teapot about to explode?
sentences.zh: 你是一个即将爆炸的茶壶吗？
